editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood gem serving handmade dumplings and authentic northeastern Chinese dishes that transport diners straight to Beijing.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the dumplings—they're made to order and worth the wait, arriving steaming hot in a basket; go in-person for the full experience rather than delivery, and don't miss the northern-style squid with sweet and chili sauce.
signatureDishes: Northern style squid with sweet and chili sauce
